title: Portal thresholds and session compactor navigation pattern
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary:
This ticket covers a focused redesign of entry points and session affordances across the Redwood Console: a compact ‘portal threshold’ component for the main sidebar plus a ‘session compactor’ pattern for quickly switching workspaces and routing between per-tenant dashboards. The goal is to reduce time-to-context and surface routing intent for multi-tenant users while preserving compactness for power users and low-screen real estate contexts.

Goals:
- Establish a single, lightweight entry component (portal threshold) that adapts to user role and workspace density (showing 1–5 items with overflow behavior).
- Design a session compactor microflow that lets users suspend, swap, or clone sessions (useful for canary rollouts and cross-workspace diagnostics).
- Provide clear routing affordances (route preview, expected latency/cost lens when switching models or dedicated capacity).
- Reduce accidental workspace switches and ensure rollback/undo affordances for routing mistakes.

Constraints & Considerations:
- Must integrate with the existing left-rail but allow an opt-in compact mode for narrow viewports and Engineers who prefer single-line navigation.
- Need to show token-cost and latency indicators at a glance without overwhelming the entry.
- Accessibility: keyboard-first flows for switching + ARIA announcements for session operations.
- Performance: component should not add >30ms to initial nav render.

Scope / Deliverables:
- High-fidelity Figma screens for three density states (sparse, standard, dense).
- Clickable prototype demonstrating: hover preview, quick-switch, suspend/clone session, undo toast.
- Interaction spec for keyboard shortcuts and focus trap behavior.
- Hand-off assets and a short dev checklist for integration (edge cases, telemetry hooks).

Acceptance criteria:
- Prototype validates switching flow with <3 clicks and a clear undo path.
- Usability test (n=8) shows median successful workspace switch in <4s without errors.
- Design tokens and spacing align with the Console design system.
- Dev checklist includes telemetry events for switch, suspend, clone, undo, and overflow reveal.

decisions: Use a single portal threshold component that toggles between condensed pill and expanded mini-menu based on viewport and user preference.
Surface a subtle cost/latency badge on route preview; clicking the badge expands a short explainer rather than redirecting.
Session compactor will implement three actions: Suspend (pause session), Swap (move session to another workspace), Clone (duplicate session into new workspace).
Undo will be implemented via a dismissible toast with ‘Revert’ action for 10s; long-term rollbacks will be tracked in audit logs in Private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Clickable prototype demonstrates hover preview, quick-switch, suspend/clone, and undo toast.
Usability metric: median successful switch <4s in moderated tests (n=8).
Design tokens used and spacing documented in handoff file.
Telemetry spec included with event names: portal.open, portal.switch, portal.suspend, portal.clone, portal.undo, portal.overflow_open.
